title: New Mexico
description: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

title: Enemy of the Law
description: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

title: Heartland
description: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

title: Hurricane Horseman
description: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

title: Six-Gun Trail
description: Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Raiders of Red Gap
description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

title: Raiders of Old California
description: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

title: Fighting Westerner
description: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

title: Death Valley
description: When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.

title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
description: Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.

title: Colorado Kid
description: A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.

title: The Two-Gun Man
description: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: A Lust to Kill
description: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
description: Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and vows to retake the land that once belonged to his forefathers.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E07 — Beware No Tresspassing
Trouble at a tungsten mine in San Pablo, Mexico.

description:

Pat and Stoney tangle with a gang of robbers who have hijacked an Army payroll.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:

Pat and Stoney investigate how U.S. currency in a bank vault was replaced by counterfeit money.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E14 — Salted Mines
Pat and Stoney get reports that a man is selling mines to investors that have been salted; the two g-men are determined to discover the truth.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E08 — Kate's Recipe for Hot Rhubarb
Kate decides it is time for Betty Jo to put down the books and set out to find a significant other.

A pair of crooks plans to rob the Cannonball of its bank shipment.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E10 — Bedloe Strikes Again
Homer returns to Shady Rest in an attempt to scrap the Cannonball.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E11 — Uncle Joe's Replacement
General store clerk Herbie Bates, is name assistant general manager of the Shady Rest by Kate, making Uncle Joe feel like he is being replaced.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E19 — The Reckless Press
Annie, Lofty and Tagg (Gail Davis, Brad Johnson, Jimmy Hawkins) attend a friend's wedding and investigate the best man's murder.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E20 — Flint and Steel
Annie (Gail Davis) uncovers a scheme involving honest ranchers, a band of greedy crooks and a valuable oil pool. With Monte Blue, Jim Bannon.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E21 — Tagg Oakley, Sheriff
A contractor agrees to deliver government gunpowder to Geronimo.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E22 — The Waco Kid
Annie's childhood sweetheart has become an outlaw, the Waco Kid.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E23 — The Saga of Clement O'Toole
A clumsy fortune-hunter doubles for a notorious gunfighter.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E03 — Gunplay
An outlaw (Myron Healey) poses as a marshal in an attempt to free his brother from jail. With Paul McGuire, Gail Davis.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E04 — The Dude Stagecoach
Annie (Gail Davis) challenges a mine owner's spoiled rich daughter (Maura Murphy) to a race. With Tom London.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E06 — Annie Calls Her Shots
After being framed and serving seven years in prison, a bitter man (Harry Lauter) returns to town. With Gail Davis.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: Loser's End
description: A cowboy (Jack Perrin) and his sidekick (Frank Rice) pursue a gang of smugglers and save a Mexican dancer (Tina Menard).

title: Range War
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and sidekick Lucky (Russell Hayden) help a railroad man (Matt Moore) thwart a land baron.

title: Fighting Caravans
description: A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).

title: Land of Hunted Men
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.

title: The Painted Desert
description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

title: Fugitive of the Plains
description: Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.

title: Revenge of the Virgins
description: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

title: Broadway to Cheyenne
description: A New York police officer, shot and wounded by a gangster, travels to Cheyenne, Wyo., to recuperate at his family's ranch, and is surprised to find a bootlegger from New York running a speakeasy there.

title: Raiders of the Border
description: U.S. marshals (Johnny Mack Brown, Raymond Hatton) catch rustlers swapping cattle for Mexican jewels.

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E16 — Mysterious Decoy
Hooded vigilantes are involved in a boundary dispute.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E17 — Ridge of Ghosts
A gold watch is the only clue to a string of murders.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:

The agents investigate a hanging judge in Oklahoma for the state authorities.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E22 — Rawhiders
Agents go to Washington territory to investigate an imposter posing as a U.S. Secret Service agent.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:

Uncle Joe becomes a justice of the peace with hopes of attracting honeymooners.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:

A brochure for the Shady Rest Hotel of the future is prematurely distributed.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:

Homer plans to keep the Cannonball from making its Christmas caroling tour.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:

Herby Bates, who is sweet on Billie Jo, won't be seeing much more of her, he has just been drafted.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E19 — Eyes of Texas
Even though Judge Roy Bean temporarily loses his eyesight, he's still able to uncover a plot to steal Indian land.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E02 — Family Ties
In Family Ties, Judge Bean comes to the aid of the Peralta family as unscrupulous real estate agents try to force them off their land. They've learned that a railroad will need the property, and they intend to make an undeserved profit.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E12 — The Fugitive
Thieves posing as newspapermen attempt to blackmail a local rancher to steal his land and property.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E21 — The Hidden Truth
Judge Bean discovers that a young vagabond he jailed for a minor offense might be involved in a major unsolved gold heist.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E32 — The Hypnotist
Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, a con involving the Haunted Hills draws Judge Roy's attention.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E09 — Judge Declares a Holiday
The judge meets up with a con man who comes to towns and arranges horse races; he then skips town with the receipts and all the money that was bet.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Judge's Dilemma
A gang plans to take over the town by getting Judge Bean to resign over false misconduct charges.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Katcina Doll
Shorts and Hurley hold a doll hostage that brings good luck to a Mexican village.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Ghost Town Gold
description: The Three Mesquiteers set out to trap outlaws who have robbed a bank and stashed the loot in an abandoned village.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: Arizona Thunderbolt
description: A circus performer (Joe Cook) and his piano-playing partner (Robert Cummings) go after a pair of ruthless rustlers.

title: The Diamond Trail
description: A New York reporter (Rex Bell) follows a gang of gem smugglers west.

title: Son of the Renegade
description: A man (John Carpenter) takes over a ranch left by his outlaw father.

title: Hellgate
description: After the Civil War, ranch owner Gil Hanley helps a stranger in desperate need of medical attention. Soon he is questioned by Union soldiers about the stranger, who turns out to be an ex-Confederate soldier.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E26 — Water Rights
A crooked stagecoach driver accuses Cisco and Pancho of stealing $50,000 from him.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E01 — Boomerang
A prominent investment broker is captured after scheming to have two of his men impersonate Cisco and Pancho at a bank hold-up.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E04 — Big Switch
A clever criminal hopes to rob a wealthy rancher, but Cisco and Pancho bring the man to justice.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E05 — Convict Story
An escaped convict is nearly murdered while trying to prove that he did not commit a crime.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E23 — Black Jack Ketchum
An outlaw convinces the son of a former gang-member to join his gang.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E24 — Tom Horn
Matt's old friend, Tom Horn, turns into an outlaw and starts a land war.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E25 — Ben Thompson
Matt and Frankie look into Ben Thompson's background; Matt gets a job at a gambling den to obtain evidence about Ben's criminal activities.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E26 — Clay Allison
Matt arrests John Allison; Frankie's doctor is kidnapped; Clay falls into Matt's trap.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E10 — The Last Viking
For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E11 — The Trail Gang
An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E12 — The Savage
Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E13 — Silent Thunder
Little Joe runs into romantic complications when he tries to teach a deaf girl sign language; guest Albert Salmi.

title: Wagon Wheels
description: An Oregon Trail scout (Randolph Scott) woos a member (Gail Patrick) of his wagon train in Indian country.

title: Billy the Kid Returns
description: Singing Billy (Roy Rogers) settles a case of mistaken identity with his sidekick, Frog (Smiley Burnette).

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: The Man From Utah
description: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.
